correctness.rationale: A reversible unit parametrization of ordered zero triples gives (t^2+t+1)^2=0. CRT reduces to prime powers; simple cubic roots lift uniquely at p=1 modulo 3, no roots exist at p=2 modulo 3, and every 3-adic candidate has valuation exactly one. Hensel lifting gives the factor p^floor(a/2); three-adic obstruction gives zero for a>=3. Character orthogonality gives the cubic moment. Full independent pair enumeration for all 299 moduli through 300 corroborates finite cases, not infinity.
